title: A quick reality check for AI devs that are not one-prompt, such as myself.
author: PoopsMcScoots
selftext:
I think there needs to be a distinction between people who use AI in dev versus people who AI to dev.

Catch that?

IN vs TO.

Massive distinction.

In, meaning you use AI tools, but you are still involved in the creating process.

To, meaning telling an AI “make me a game”.

MASSIVE distinction.

I use AI in dev.

And I have accepted, as I hope all of you have, that the second I make anything that even resembles success that people who use AI to dev are going to flood the market with knockoffs.

And I have also accepted that when that happens that I will have zero sympathy because most people don’t make that distinction.

And it will ultimately come down to media presence and advertising, which I will certainly lose at.

I hope everyone here has the sense to know that this will forever be a financially fruitless effort it terms of income.

So only do it if you enjoy doing it.
